# Link-Span API Reference

API version: `0.5.0`. Schema version: `1`.

## Types

| Name | Kind | Contract | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `game_id` | `enum` | `oot`, `mm` | Public identifier of the host game. |
| `subscription` | `opaque` | Lua `integer` | Opaque identifier of an event subscription. |
| `timer_handle` | `opaque` | Lua `integer` | Opaque identifier of a frame timer. |
| `event_options` | `object` | `priority: integer?` | Deterministic subscription options. |
| `actor_handle` | `object` | `kind: string`, `slot: integer`, `generation: integer`, `scene_generation: integer` | Opaque handle validated by kind, slot, generation and scene. |
| `actor_position` | `object` | `x: number`, `y: number`, `z: number` | Finite absolute position in world coordinates. |
| `actor_rotation` | `object` | `x: number`, `y: number`, `z: number` | XYZ rotation in degrees. |
| `actor_spawn_options` | `object` | `position: actor_position`, `rotation: actor_rotation?` | Safe transform for spawning an actor. |
| `operation_error` | `object` | `code: string`, `message: string` | Structured error returned without raising lua_error. |
| `actor_snapshot` | `object` | `handle: actor_handle`, `actor_id: integer`, `category: integer`, `params: integer?` | Minimal, stable snapshot of an actor; params is Actor.params in OoT. |
| `hotkey_options` | `object` | `default: string?`, `label: string?` | Hotkey registration options (default key and label). |
| `game_state` | `object` | `mode: string`, `save_slot: integer?` | Stable gameplay state without exposing native structs. |
| `hud_icon_options` | `object` | `alpha: integer?` | Bounded presentation options for a HUD icon. |
| `attribute_breakdown_entry` | `object` | `modifier: string`, `item: string?`, `op: string`, `value: number` | Active modifier in an attribute's total; item is absent when the modifier has no target. |
| `attribute_modifier_view` | `object` | `id: string`, `attribute: string`, `op: string`, `value: number`, `when: string`, `via: string?` | Modifier an item provides; via is the tag through which the item matched. |
| `attribute_modifier` | `object` | `id: string`, `attribute: string`, `op: string`, `value: number`, `target: string?`, `when: string?` | Runtime modifier: id with the mod prefix, op add, multiply_base or multiply_total, an item or #tag target and when equipped or owned. |

## Events

| Event | Kind | Phase | Hosts | Cancellable | Capability | Payload | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `game.ready` | `observe` | `mvp` | `oot`, `mm` | no | — | `game_id: game_id`, `host_version: string`, `runtime_version: string`, `api_version: string` | Emitted after loading mods and preparing the host API; the payload identifies the game and versions. Does not guarantee a loaded save or playable scene and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `game.frame` | `observe` | `mvp` | `oot`, `mm` | no | — | `frame: integer` | Emitted on each host frame after advancing timers; frame is the scheduler counter. It is a notification, with no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `game.shutdown` | `observe` | `mvp` | `oot`, `mm` | no | — | — | Notifies host shutdown, with no payload. It is not cancellable and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result; it is not a crash recovery guarantee. |
| `scene.enter` | `observe` | `host_bridge` | `oot`, `mm` | no | `scene.events` | `scene_id: integer` | Notifies entry into a scene; scene_id identifies the scene. It is not cancellable and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `actor.init` | `observe` | `host_bridge` | `oot`, `mm` | no | `actor.events` | `actor: actor_snapshot` | Notifies actor initialization; actor contains its handle, identifier and category. The OoT host emits the event for every actor, after init. It is not cancellable and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `actor.update` | `observe` | `host_bridge` | `oot`, `mm` | no | `actor.events` | `actor: actor_snapshot` | Notifies an actor update; actor contains its handle, identifier and category. The OoT host does not emit this event, for cost reasons. It is not cancellable and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `actor.destroy` | `observe` | `host_bridge` | `oot`, `mm` | no | `actor.events` | `handle: actor_handle` | Notifies actor destruction; handle identifies the destroyed actor. It is not cancellable and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `save.loaded` | `observe` | `host_bridge` | `oot`, `mm` | no | `save.events` | `slot: integer` | In OoT, emitted after loading a save, on the first frame when the player exists; slot identifies the save. It is a notification, with no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `save.saving` | `observe` | `host_bridge` | `oot` | no | `save.events` | `slot: integer` | In OoT, emitted before the game writes the file, with the SaveContext not yet copied; slot identifies the file. It is a notification, with no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `text.open` | `observe` | `host_bridge` | `oot`, `mm` | no | `text.events` | `text_id: integer` | Notifies a text opening; text_id identifies the message. It is not cancellable and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `audio.sequence_started` | `observe` | `host_bridge` | `oot`, `mm` | no | `audio.sequence.events` | `player_index: integer`, `sequence_id: integer` | Notifies an audio sequence starting; player_index identifies the sequence player and sequence_id the sequence. Accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `input.hotkey` | `observe` | `host_bridge` | `oot`, `mm` | no | — | `action: string`, `key: string` | Notifies activation of a registered hotkey; action is its id and key the associated key. It is not cancellable and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `input.action` | `transform` | `host_bridge` | `oot` | no | `input.actions` | `action: string`, `pressed: boolean`, `source: string` | Emitted in gameplay for D-pad or C-button presses; action identifies the direction, pressed is true and source is controller. ship.hooks.result(true) consumes the press before the game handles it. |
| `hook.oot.player.speed.run` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `speed: number` | Emitted when calculating target running speed; speed is its current value. ship.hooks.result with a floating-point number replaces the speed; it does not cancel movement. |
| `hook.oot.player.fall_damage` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | — | Emitted when the game decides whether to apply fall damage, with no payload. ship.hooks.result(false) prevents that damage; a boolean result decides whether it is applied. |
| `hook.oot.item.receive` | `observe` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `item_id: integer`, `get_item_id: integer` | Notifies item reception; item_id and get_item_id identify the received entry. It neither cancels nor replaces the item through ship.hooks.result. |
| `hook.oot.player.health_change` | `observe` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `amount: integer` | Notifies a health change; amount is the quantity reported by the native hook. It neither cancels nor alters the change through ship.hooks.result. |
| `hook.oot.player.bonk` | `observe` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | — | Notifies a player bonk collision, with no payload. It is not cancellable and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `hook.oot.enemy.defeat` | `observe` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `actor: actor_snapshot`, `actor_id: integer`, `category: integer`, `pos_x: number`, `pos_y: number`, `pos_z: number` | Notifies an enemy defeat reported by the game; the payload carries the actor's snapshot, id, category and position. It does not represent every actor destruction and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `hook.oot.actor.damage` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `target_id: integer`, `target_category: integer`, `attacker_id: integer`, `attacker_category: integer`, `attacker_is_player: boolean`, `dmg_flags: integer`, `damage_effect: integer`, `base_damage: number`, `damage: number`, `target: actor_snapshot`, `attacker: actor_snapshot?`, `target_health: integer`, `target_max_health: integer`, `target_extended: boolean` | Emitted before adding collision damage to an actor without AC_HARD, before the cooperative multiplier, once per hit element. target_id and target_category identify the target; attacker_id and attacker_category identify the owner of the AT collider that hit the element and are -1 without an attacker. attacker_is_player indicates AT_TYPE_PLAYER; dmg_flags carries toucher.dmgFlags and damage_effect carries the computed effect. base_damage is the damage calculated by the game and damage is the value after native hooks. ship.hooks.result with a finite number replaces damage, clamped by the host to 0..255; if any native or Lua hook changed the value, the host also clamps it to what is left up to 255 in the target's accumulated u8 damage, before the cooperative multiplier. No result or a nonnumeric result preserves damage. Damage outside this path is not covered: boss health deductions that do not use central damage, grabs using play->damagePlayer, knockback damage, falls, fire and traps on those paths. With target_extended, damage is in the target's extended health units and the limit is 0..65535 and the remaining health, instead of 0..255. |
| `hook.oot.actor.damaged` | `observe` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `target: actor_snapshot`, `amount: integer`, `health: integer`, `max_health: integer`, `extended: boolean` | Notifies the damage an actor actually lost, when it applies damage (Actor_ApplyDamage) or when the host confirms an extended debit. amount is in the target's units; health and max_health are the health after the damage. Does not cover Link nor bosses with their own math. |
| `hook.oot.item.give` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `item_id: integer`, `get_item_id: integer` | Emitted before giving an item; item_id and get_item_id describe the current entry. ship.hooks.result with a valid integer get_item_id replaces the entry using the vanilla table; it is not cancellation. |
| `hook.oot.hud.draw` | `observe` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hud.draw` | — | Emitted after drawing the world and before the native HUD, with no payload. This is the valid window for ship.hud.draw_*; it accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `hook.oot.player.first_person_control` | `observe` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `held_item_action: integer` | Emitted each frame while first-person control is active; held_item_action identifies the held item's action. It is a notification, with no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `hook.oot.player.arrow_type_select` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `magic_arrow_type: integer`, `arrow_type: integer` | Emitted when selecting the arrow for magic consumption; magic_arrow_type and arrow_type are the current types. ship.hooks.result with an integer replaces arrow_type; it does not cancel firing. |
| `hook.oot.player.body_anim_select` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `oot` | no | `oot.player.custom_body` | `speed: number`, `on_ground: boolean`, `rolling: boolean`, `roll_charge: integer`, `roll_phase: string`, `falling: boolean`, `landing: boolean`, `climbing: boolean`, `climb_direction: string`, `climb_step: integer`, `climb_starting: boolean`, `door_opening: boolean`, `door_direction: string`, `chest_opening: boolean`, `instrument: boolean`, `attacking: boolean`, `attack_animation: integer` | Emitted during automatic custom body animation selection when no override owns the pose; the payload summarizes movement and actions. ship.hooks.result with a name present in anims selects the animation. |
| `hook.mm.player.speed.walk` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `mm` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `speed: number` | Movement speed transformation point in MM; speed is the current value. The example sends the modified speed through ship.hooks.result; this is not movement cancellation. |
| `hook.mm.player.goron_roll.consume_magic` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `mm` | no | `hooks.bridge` | — | Decision point for consuming magic during Goron rolling, with no payload. The example uses ship.hooks.result(false) to prevent consumption. |
| `hook.mm.player.goron_roll.disable_spike_mode` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `mm` | no | `hooks.bridge` | — | Decision point for leaving Goron rolling spike mode, with no payload. The example uses ship.hooks.result(false) to keep the mode active. |
| `hook.mm.player.goron_roll.increase_spike_level` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `mm` | no | `hooks.bridge` | — | Decision point for increasing the Goron rolling spike level, with no payload. The example uses ship.hooks.result(true) to allow the increase. |
| `hook.mm.item.give` | `observe` | `hook_bridge` | `mm` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `item: integer` | Notifies an item being given in MM; item identifies the item. It is not cancellable and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `hook.mm.enemy.defeat` | `observe` | `hook_bridge` | `mm` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `actor_id: integer`, `category: integer`, `pos_x: number`, `pos_y: number`, `pos_z: number` | Notifies an enemy defeat in MM; the payload carries the actor's id, category and position. It is not cancellable and accepts no decision via ship.hooks.result. |
| `hook.mm.item.should_give` | `transform` | `hook_bridge` | `mm` | no | `hooks.bridge` | `item: integer` | Decision point for giving an item in MM; item identifies the item being evaluated. The response uses ship.hooks.result according to the host contract. |

## Capabilities

| Capability | Status | Hosts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `core.events` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Core host events and lifecycle. |
| `hooks.bridge` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Generic bridge to the native instrumentation points (GameInteractor VB_*/On*): hook.* events you subscribe to with ship.events.on and decide with ship.hooks.result, without a dedicated native function per ability. |
| `core.timers` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Per-frame timers owned by each mod. |
| `core.input` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Hotkey registration and input events. |
| `core.menu` | `contract` | `oot` | Declarative per-mod menu pages, with values persisted only in ship.storage and input delivered outside the draw pass. |
| `core.attributes` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Item attributes, modifiers and tags shared across mods (RFC 0030); values are computed from the active items reported by registered sources. |
| `core.modules` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | require of .lua modules from the mod's own package (RFC 0031). |
| `core.save` | `contract` | `oot` | Mod data inside the loaded save file (RFC 0031). |
| `input.actions` | `contract` | `oot` | Emits consumable directional controller actions; vanilla input is blocked only when a callback accepts the action. |
| `game.state` | `contract` | `oot` | Exposes a stable gameplay mode: pause, dialog, cutscene, transition, death, loading or unavailable. |
| `core.storage` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Key-value storage namespaced per mod, persisted to disk across sessions. |
| `core.storage.shared` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Key-value storage SHARED between both games (same file in the launcher session directory). Namespaced per mod, but the same mod sees the same state in OoT and MM: the basis for cross-game randomizer progress and stats that survive world travel. |
| `oot.cutscene` | `contract` | `oot` | Takes over the camera for a number of frames with a dedicated subcamera, freezing actors and entering cutscene mode: the dramatic framing MM uses for mask transformations. Generic: works for transformations, items, reveals. |
| `oot.env` | `contract` | `oot` | Reads ENVIRONMENT state (separate from the player): time_of_day (0..1), is_night (0/1) and scene_id. Basis for mechanics that react to time of day and location. |
| `hud.draw` | `contract` | `oot` | Draws rectangles and text over the game HUD from the hook.<game>.hud.draw event. Generic primitive: the host knows nothing about 'health bars' or 'hunger meters'; the mod composes whatever it wants from rectangles and text. |
| `hud.icons` | `contract` | `oot` | Draws a texture registered in the resource manager as a HUD icon, with bounded size and alpha. |
| `scene.events` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Common scene events. |
| `actor.events` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Common actor events with handles and snapshots. |
| `actor.spawn` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Spawns an allowlisted actor with ownership and a safe handle. |
| `actor.destroy` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Destroys an actor owned by the calling mod. |
| `actor.exists` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Checks whether an actor handle owned by the mod is still valid. |
| `actor.observe` | `contract` | `oot` | Observation handles for game actors and reading with ship.actor.get (RFC 0031). |
| `actor.health` | `contract` | `oot` | Per-actor extended health above 255, mirrored on the vanilla scale (RFC 0031). |
| `audio.play` | `contract` | `oot` | Sound effects and fanfares by id (RFC 0031). |
| `save.events` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Common save-load events. |
| `text.events` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Common read-only text events. |
| `audio.sequence.events` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Audio sequence start events. |
| `world.travel` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Requests an authenticated handoff to a logical destination in the other host. |
| `mm.room.events` | `planned` | `mm` | Room events exclusive to Majora's Mask. |
| `mm.cycle` | `planned` | `mm` | Three-day cycle lifecycle. |
| `mm.owl_save` | `planned` | `mm` | Owl save semantics. |
| `mm.clock` | `planned` | `mm` | Stable read of the MM clock. |
| `mm.player.jump` | `contract` | `mm` | Applies a validated vertical impulse to the Majora's Mask player while on the ground. |
| `mm.spawn_dog` | `contract` | `mm` | Spawns the Clock Town dog (En_Dg) near the Majora's Mask player. |
| `mm.player.sword_skin` | `contract` | `mm` | Switches the held Kokiri Sword between the Majora's Mask model and the Ocarina of Time one (read from the neighboring oot.o2r). |
| `oot.player.jump` | `contract` | `oot` | Applies a validated vertical impulse to the OoT player while on the ground. |
| `oot.player.mask` | `contract` | `oot` | Equips any OoT mask by logical name, without taking a C button. |
| `player.speed` | `contract` | `oot`, `mm` | Multiplies the player's movement speed by a validated factor (0.1 to 5.0); 1.0 restores it. |
| `player.fields` | `contract` | `oot` | Reads and writes named player fields with range validation: health, health_capacity, magic, rupees, pos_x/y/z, rot_y, speed, vel_x/y/z (read and write); on_ground, rolling, swimming (read only); climbing (read; writing 0 releases the player from the ladder and makes them fall); screen_x, screen_y (read only: the player's projection on screen, to anchor HUD to the character instead of a fixed corner). Keys outside this list become free per-session storage. |
| `oot.player.attach_model` | `contract` | `oot` | Draws an arbitrary display list on the player by resource path, including mod assets and assets from the neighboring game. |
| `mod.assets` | `contract` | `oot` | Archives (.o2r/.otr) in the mods folder become addressable under mod/<name>/, so a mod can ship its own content. |
| `oot.player.immunity` | `contract` | `oot` | Grants immunity to a damage type (currently: fire). |
| `oot.player.weight` | `contract` | `oot` | Toggles the player's weight between normal and heavy (sinks in water, resists pushes). |
| `oot.player.roll` | `contract` | `oot` | Blocks the player from starting a roll (set_roll_blocked). |
| `oot.player.custom_body` | `contract` | `oot` | Replaces the player's visual body with a skeleton and named animations supplied by the mod, surviving scene changes. Visual only: the form's abilities (rolling, punching, swimming) belong to the mod. |
| `oot.player.held_item_model` | `contract` | `oot` | Draws an arbitrary DL anchored to the player's hand bone, updated every frame: the mechanism most custom items with a model in hand need. |
| `oot.ocarina` | `planned` | `oot` | OoT ocarina events and state. |
| `oot.dungeon_keys` | `planned` | `oot` | OoT dungeon key state. |
| `oot.equipment` | `planned` | `oot` | OoT-specific equipment. |

## Error codes

`unsupported`, `invalid_argument`, `invalid_handle`, `invalid_state`, `permission_denied`, `resource_limit`, `host_failure`, `script_failure`.
